guards: Keep source word and linked lemma spelling/accents intact. Grammar-only accent/case folding must not create lexical aliases or merge accents.
Finite person/number/mood/tense must come from the explicit same-sense source grammar. Preserve competing source analyses separately; never infer from a suffix.

Preserve usted/ustedes semantic address metadata and adapt to the existing English imperative renderer: singular formal and plural non-Spain/ustedes commands must not become informal or Spain-only commands.
Futuro imperfecto is simple future. Pretérito imperfecto is imperfect. Futuro perfecto, condicional perfecto, compound/perfect, pluscuamperfecto and anterior constructions remain unsupported.
Withhold negative imperatives before English generation; retaining a negative flag during research does not authorize an affirmative imperative.
Inspect grammatical qualifiers after the exact linked lemma too. Explicit enclitic/pronoun/compound restrictions cannot be lost by cutting the prefix.

Only explicit participio pasado/pasivo descriptions are supported; bare, negated, active, present, future or compound participles remain unavailable. Past participle is a grammatical category, not a factual assertion of past time.
Agreement recognition must be anchored to explicit form-description prefixes and exact linked target boundaries. Do not treat a lexical lemma named femenino/masculino/plural/presente as grammar.

Noun forms still require independently approved countability, singular/plural, selected sense and real female counterpart mappings. Grammatical feminine alone must not fabricate English female kinship/person/animal terms.
Adjective agreement can retain the same English adjective only under matching POS/selected source meaning and retained usage restrictions.
Voseo tagging for tú, vos descriptions means voseo-compatible, not voseo-exclusive; retain shared-person variants honestly.

All normalized research candidates must still pass the existing approved lexical predicate, source-usage, subject-profile, aspect, AGID and unknown-form constraints. Grammar recovery alone is not translated-word coverage.
rejectedPatterns: … de <linked lemma> (con el pronombre enclítico) or any other nonpunctuation post-target qualifier
Bare participio; participio no pasado; participio activo/presente/futuro
Exact lexical target accent/Ñ mismatches or contradictory formal-address number metadata
notes: Independent model review reread all 118 v2 samples covering 62 grammar patterns and independently recomputed every normalization exactly. Read-only counterexample checks passed: usted/ustedes imperative adapter and recorded reason; original-source semantic third-person alternatives retained; post-target enclitic qualifier rejection; negative and perfect-compound withholding; futuro imperfecto versus pretérito imperfecto; explicit past/passive participles only; exact NFC lexical target preserving PAPÁ/PAPA and Ñ/N distinctions; FEMENINO lemma excluded from grammar markers. The v1 issues are resolved in this exact parser/sample version. This approves bounded grammar recognition only; 16,197 potential research words are not verified translations and still require existing lexical/predicate/subject/aspect/AGID/countability/gender safeguards. No project source edits, new linguistic examples counted as coverage, or native-Mexican certification.

resolvedIssues.case: Samples 5/6 LOSE/PIRE and 22/23 CROEN/HALEN formal imperative headers
resolvedIssues.reason: Source usted/ustedes forms normalize as second-person singular/plural without a formal-address feature; the existing renderer labels these informal singular / Spain plural. A typed address/register adapter is required before reuse.

resolvedIssues.case: Sample 85 QUEJATE / quejarse (con el pronombre enclítico)
resolvedIssues.reason: The post-target explicit enclitic qualifier is omitted from prefix checks, so an unsupported combined/reflexive form is normalized as a bare imperative.

resolvedIssues.case: Isolated source-style future-perfect and conditional-perfect descriptions
resolvedIssues.reason: Futuro perfecto and condicional perfecto are accepted as simple future/conditional because only compuesto/pluscuamperfecto/anterior are excluded. These should be withheld.
Normalizer returns an imperative plus negative flag; a production caller must explicitly reject it instead of rendering a positive command.
